ops.title: cc-steer v14.5: design §1 store done; 5 unscoped non-store parser/discovery/activity/context breaks block suite
ops.body:
Migrating cc-steer to cc-transcript v14.5 (branch v14-5-async-migration). The binding design (doc a6439b47) §1 covered ONLY the async store composition. That part is DONE + verified (store.py composition over BaseFeedbackStore+STEER_SCHEMA; all raw `.store.conn` consumers → sql/execute/executemany delegators; watch daemon holds a platform Watcher and awaits `_tailer.tick()`; native readonly write-rejection verified: OperationalError "attempt to write a readonly database").

BLOCKER (check-back): bumping cc-transcript 13.2→14.5 breaks 5 NON-store symbols the design never scoped/mapped, cascading to 21 pytest collection errors:
1. cc_transcript.TranscriptParser + .stream_transcripts([(path,mtime)]) — GONE. New: parser.stream(paths: Iterable[Path]) -> Iterator[Transcript] (SYNC, mtimes dropped). (negatives.py, scan.py)
2. cc_transcript.TranscriptDiscovery (class) — GONE. New: discovery module funcs discover()/find_in(known_mtimes=)/resolve()/subagent_transcripts(). (sidecar.py, scan.py, context_rebuild.py)
3. cc_transcript.parser.parse_events_async (async) — GONE. New: parse()/parse_events()/stream() all SYNC → sync/async shape change through async callers. (sidecar.py, enrich.py, context_rebuild.py)
4. cc_transcript.activity.lift_turn — GONE, NO discoverable replacement (needs v14 activity-refactor investigation). (capture.py)
5. cc_transcript.context.turn_ref(turn, Budget) — GONE. New turn_ref_from(payload: Mapping) has a different signature; window rendering approach changed. (capture.py, daemon.py)

In-scope deviations already applied (forced/mechanical): (a) inlined local EVENT_COLUMNS in store.py (platform dropped its export in 14.5 commit 9456006); (b) CorrectionLog.open() is now async (design only flagged for_anchor) → awaited at export/enrich/cli/dashboard; the dashboard evidence path (evidence_resolver→report.Lineage.from_lineage→routes→build_app) propagated async because for_anchor is async.

Nothing committed/pushed. Store §1 diff is clean and reviewable.
